== Biography ==
Elizabeth was born in 1744. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-3944|James Glasgow]] and [[Unknown-762859|Catherine Unknown]].

=== Lanesborough namesake ===
A 1765 County Leitrim probate-index occurrence was entered as Elizabeth Mulveehil or Glasco of Lanesborough. Her age and relationships are not stated. She is a possible namesake of this Elizabeth, but the different locality and alternate surname prevent identification.<ref>[https://apps.proni.gov.uk/ProniNames_IE/SearchPage.aspx Underlying record source: elizabeth mulveehil or glasco].</ref>
